subject: AWS Marketplace private offer — pilot structure, multi-account activation, and true-up
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Anita Rao <anita.rao@medsource.com>
Cc: Carlos Jimenez <c.jimenez@medsource.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: AWS Marketplace private offer — pilot structure, multi-account activation, and true-up

Hi Anita —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're excited about the potential at MedSource and wanted to propose a private offer path that matches your procurement and multi-account needs. High level ask from your side: a 9-month pilot that can be expanded across five AWS accounts, with a usage-based true-up at pilot close followed by a potential committed term.

Two quick confirmations we need to build the private offer:
- Confirm pilot billing treatment: do you want the pilot to be invoiced with a true-up (invoice +/- credit) or treated as a credit against a future committed PO?
- Please provide the list of AWS account IDs that should be enabled at activation, and the procurement/finance approvers (name + email).

I've attached a one-page SOW and an AWS PO template for reference. If you're ok with the structure, I'll loop in Marketplace ops and legal to draft the private offer.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm billing treatment + approver list this week
2) We send a draft private offer and evidence pack for your procurement team
3) Once PO is accepted in the AWS Console, we provision cross-account entitlements (if required) — typical lead time 3-7 business days

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: MedSource_SOW_v1.pdf (1 page), AWS_PO_Template.pdf (template)

From: Anita Rao <anita.rao@medsource.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Jimenez <c.jimenez@medsource.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jan 2028 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace private offer — pilot structure, multi-account activation, and true-up

Sofia —

Appreciate the quick follow. A few clarifications from procurement/IT:
1) Pricing cap: Procurement wants a not-to-exceed for the pilot (we typically ask for a monthly cap). Can you propose a per-month ceiling based on expected usage tiers?
2) Billing: MedSource prefers invoice-based true-up — invoice at pilot close with credits applied to the first committed invoice if we proceed.
3) Multi-account: We operate under an AWS Organization with a centralized payer. We'll need the private offer accepted by a single account but then entitlements enabled across linked accounts. Please confirm whether Redwood supports that flow (Marketplace Entitlement API or Payer account provisioning).
4) Security/compliance: Please attach SOC 2 Type II and data residency statement. Our security team may request extra evidence.
5) Approvers: finance@medsource.com (Maria Gonzales, VP Finance) and procurement@medsource.com (me) for now. I'll loop in CIO if needed.

Attaching our procurement checklist — it lists required artifacts and signature windows.

Thanks,
Anita Rao
Procurement Lead | MedSource Health
anita.rao@medsource.com

Hi Jordan / Vanessa —

Looping you both in on MedSource's asks (procurement checklist attached). Quick summary:
- They want a 9-month pilot with an invoice-based true-up at pilot close (applied as credit if they convert).
- Operate under an AWS Organization with centralized billing — they'd like entitlements across linked accounts after a single PO acceptance.
- Procurement wants a monthly not-to-exceed cap for the pilot tiers.
- Security asked for SOC 2 and data residency confirmation.

Could you each advise on two things:
1) Jordan — proposed legal/contract path (pilot addendum language, post-pilot true-up timing, and any required data residency clause).
2) Vanessa — ops: recommended activation flow for multi-account enablement (Marketplace entitlement vs per-account private-offer acceptance), and lead time.

I've attached AWS_PO_Template.pdf — feel free to edit for the private offer flow.

Thanks,
Sofia

[Attachment: MedSource_procurement_checklist.xlsx, AWS_PO_Template.pdf]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 11:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: AWS Marketplace private offer — pilot structure, multi-account activation, and true-up

Sofia / team —

Suggested legal approach:
- Pilot addendum: 9-month pilot, defined baseline usage tiers and an agreed monthly not-to-exceed amount per tier. Pilot services delivered under a Statement of Work (attached by AE).
- True-up mechanics: invoice at pilot close with 30 days net for payment. If MedSource signs a committed PO within 45 days of pilot close, we can apply the pilot overage invoice as a credit against the first committed invoice (explicit credit application clause).
- Post-pilot term: propose a 12-month committed term (auto-renew opt-in) after pilot conversion. Include a conversion window and a mechanism to convert pilot accounts into the committed private offer to avoid double-billing.
- Data residency: include a short exhibit stating Redwood's hosting and logging practices (we'll attach SOC2 & data residency statement). If MedSource requires additional contractual guarantees (e.g., EU-only residency), escalate to SRE/legal for an addendum.
- Approvals: recommend listing procurement, finance, and security approvers by name/email on the PO to speed acceptance.

I'll draft a short pilot addendum and sample clause for the credit/true-up flow and share by EOD.

Jordan Blake
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Anita Rao <anita.rao@medsource.com>
Cc: Carlos Jimenez <c.jimenez@medsource.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jan 2028 15:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace private offer — pilot structure, multi-account activation, and true-up

Hi all —

Operational notes for Marketplace private offer + multi-account enablement:
1) Acceptance model: AWS Marketplace only requires acceptance once (the buyer accepts the private offer in the AWS Console). That acceptance is tied to the buyer account that accepts. For linked accounts under an Organization, entitlements can be enabled across accounts but require either (a) centralized payer configuration plus Seller activation via the Entitlement API, or (b) per-account acceptance if accounts want independent controls.
2) Recommended flow for MedSource (centralized payer):
   a) MedSource signs/accepts the private offer using the designated payer account (we'll include payer account ID on the offer).
   b) Redwood provisions entitlements to additional account IDs via the Marketplace Entitlement API (we'll need list of target account IDs) OR configure Consolidated Billing mapping.
   c) Typical provisioning lead time after acceptance: 3-7 business days for entitlements, longer (7-12) if we need CLS/partner enablement.
3) Billing/true-up: since procurement prefers invoice-based true-up, we will issue a pilot invoice at pilot close reflecting usage. If MedSource signs the committed PO within 45 days, the finance team can apply the pilot invoice as a credit against the first committed invoice (Jordan's proposed language). We need to record a credit memo flow in our billing system; please confirm if MedSource prefers credit memo vs refund.
4) Monthly not-to-exceed: we can publish a tiered cap table (suggested tiers: up to 250k tokens/mo, 250k-1M tokens, >1M) with corresponding per-month ceiling. Sofia — please confirm expected pilot monthly volumes so we can recommend exact caps.
5) Evidence and security: attaching SOC 2 Type II and a short data residency summary. If security requests additional evidence, we'll route to SRE.

Next actions for MedSource:
- Anita: confirm the payer account ID + list of linked account IDs to enable (5 accounts mentioned).
- Procurement/Finance: confirm credit memo vs refund preference for true-up application.
- Sofia: if we get approval on the not-to-exceed caps, we'll populate the private offer and share the DocuSign link for signature.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Marketplace Operations | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

Attachments: AWS_PO_Template.pdf, SOC2_TypeII_redwood.pdf, Data_Residency_Summary.pdf
